items.headline: Apple Works to Restore Systems After Update Caused Outage
items.excerpt: Apple Inc. is working to restore its systems after an internal update caused wide-scale outages Tuesday, disrupting employee tools, retail operations and consumer services.

items.headline: Big US Grid Proposes Overhaul to Speed Data Center Hook Ups
items.excerpt: The largest US grid is proposing a “fast energization” plan to speed up connection for data centers and power plants in response to criticism from regulators that PJM Interconnection LLC is struggling to keep pace with surging demand while costs rise for consumers.

items.headline: Genesis AI Hits $3.5B Valuation in Robotics Bet
items.excerpt: Genesis AI has raised $500 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as it develops general-purpose robots designed to eventually perform complex tasks with human-level dexterity. items.excerpt: Anthropic’s IPO is highlighting just how much value can be created before public investors ever get a chance to buy in. items.headline: Nvidia Faces First Earnings Test Since Huang’s Exit
items.excerpt: Nvidia reports earnings for the first time since Jensen Huang’s surprise departure, putting the chipmaker’s 70% growth outlook and the broader AI trade back in focus. items.headline: Anthropic Faces a Longer Wait Than SpaceX to Join Indexes
items.excerpt: Anthropic’s planned initial public offering could generate billions of dollars in demand from index-tracking funds, though the artificial intelligence startup may have to wait longer than SpaceX did to join two major stock benchmarks.

items.excerpt: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Jensen Huang's statement saying he would be willing to return as CEO if the board agreed, and that he has received an "outpouring" of support from people calling for his return. items.headline: States Press for Scrutiny in Sale of Chatbot Said to Harm Kids
items.excerpt: Dozens of state attorneys asked a federal judge to impose extra scrutiny on the proposed sale of an artificial intelligence chatbot that allegedly encouraged suicidal thoughts in a 14-year-old boy who killed himself.

items.headline: Nvidia Scandal Has Raised ‘Red Flags,’ California AG Says
items.excerpt: California Attorney General Rob Bonta said that his office is looking into aspects of the scandal that’s engulfed Nvidia Corp. and its former chief executive officer, Jensen Huang.

items.headline: US Electronic Spy Agency Suffers Classified Network Outage
items.excerpt: The National Security Agency is suffering an outage of a classified computer network it uses for internal communications and other daily work functions, according to a US official and another person familiar with the matter.

items.headline: Nvidia to Face Its New AI Reality
items.excerpt: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Nvidia takes center stage, reporting without Jensen Huang as the tech trade faces fresh pressure. items.headline: Trump Seeks $50 Billion for Airspace Upgrades After Outage
items.excerpt: President Donald Trump’s administration formally requested $50.1 billion to overhaul the US airspace system, citing an “urgent need” to modernize the critical infrastructure after a technology breakdown grounded flights nationwide last week.

items.headline: OpenAI Unveils New Astra AI Model After Scrapping Prior Release
items.excerpt: OpenAI is releasing a new version of its most advanced Astra artificial intelligence model nearly two months after the company scrapped a prior update to establish stronger safeguards for the technology.

items.headline: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Open to Rejoining as CEO Pending Board Decision
items.excerpt: Former Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang expressed willingness to return to the helm after his dramatic ouster last week, though the board isn’t currently considering such an idea.

items.headline: JPMorgan Warns Leveraged-Loan Defaults Set to Double in 2027
items.excerpt: Defaults in the leveraged-loan market are expected to more than double to 4.5% next year, reaching levels not seen since 2024 as heavily indebted companies face mounting financial pressure, according to analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

items.headline: EM Stocks Retreat Ahead of Nvidia, While Currencies Gain Ground
items.excerpt: Emerging-market stocks retreated for the fourth straight session as upcoming earnings from Nvidia Corp. kept traders on edge, while currencies extended gains after reports of another US outage pushed the dollar lower.

items.headline: New Street's Ferragu Sees Strong Case to Buy Nvidia Shares Ahead of Earnings
items.excerpt: Pierre Ferragu of New Street Research maintains a buy rating on Nvidia shares and says the recent selloff strengthens the case to buy. He says the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang won't affect near-term earnings. Ferragu speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Read Jensen Huang’s Statement Offering a Return as Nvidia CEO
items.excerpt: After his chaotic exit from Nvidia Corp. last week, former Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang said he’s received an “outpouring” of support from people calling for his return.

items.headline: Take-Two’s Firaxis, Maker of ‘Civilization,’ Cuts a Third of Its Staff
items.excerpt: The Maryland-based development studio behind the Civilization and XCOM franchises, laid off around 60 people on Tuesday

items.headline: Compute Futures Aim to Hedge AI Risks
items.excerpt: Carmen Li, founder and CEO of Silicon Data and CEO of the Compute Exchange joined Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about how compute futures could give financiers and AI companies a way to hedge shifting GPU costs and supply risks. (Source: Bloomberg)
